DEGENERACY_ESTABLISHED_BEFORE_RESULTS: 7 of the 9 named candidates collapse to 3 distinct share-space split laws: 1/p and equal-dollars both reduce exactly to 1-p; equal-shares, equal-payout and p(1-p) all reduce to 0.5. A win by one is NOT three independent confirmations.

A4_clip_scaling.TAUTOLOGY_AVOIDED: cumulative clip count necessarily rises with elapsed time, so a cumulative-count-vs-TTE rho (which measures ~-1 by construction) is NOT reported as a scaling finding. Rates and per-clip sizes are used instead.
A4_clip_scaling.VACUITY_AVOIDED: a per-window test at snapshot resolution has only 9 points and returns no rho; that is NOT evidence against A4. The per-window test runs at clip resolution instead.
